caption: The install screen asks for customer data, staff data and edit access to customers, products, orders, discounts and the Online Store.
With the Hide price + quote template the product page showed 'Login to view prices' and an Add to quote button instead of Add to cart.
On our development store the Growth plan showed as a test charge that is not billed: $19 every 30 days after a 14 day trial, no card asked.
We built a quote for 10 snowboards at a custom unit price with a freight fee. Without a product cost in Shopify the margin box stays empty.
One click turned the quote into Shopify draft order #D11 with our PO number, about 8 minutes after install.
Uninstalling asks for a reason and says app data is deleted and a request to delete customer data goes to the developer within 48 hours.
